trello.name: Renew and deploy SSL and internal CA certificates
trello.desc: Owner: Ben. Deadline: August 22nd. Renew and deploy the wildcard SSL cert for api.ourapp.com (expires September 1st). In the same change window, rotate the internal CA cert that signs the service mesh (expires two weeks after the public one). Move both certificates onto cert-manager so they auto-renew going forward.

trello.name: Implement PDF export for reports
trello.desc: Owner: Aisha. Deadline: End of month. Deliverable includes two halves: backend renders the report to PDF with headless Chrome, and frontend adds the export button and a progress state (since big reports take a few seconds). Also record a short demo GIF for the changelog for marketing as part of finishing the feature.

trello.name: Restore staging parity and add schema drift monitoring
trello.desc: Owner: Ben. Deadline: Run migrations today; nightly job ongoing. Run the three pending staging migrations today to catch up with production. Write a nightly job that diffs staging schema against production and posts to the infra channel if they diverge.
